Application Data.NAME: Glow & Radiance Inc.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Beauty Lane, Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90001-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Glow & Radiance Inc. specializes in the development and sale of high-quality cosmetics and personal care products. Our operations involve sourcing premium ingredients, formulating innovative skincare solutions, and distributing a diverse range of beauty items, including makeup, lotions, and hair care products. We focus on retail sales through both physical stores and e-commerce platforms, catering to a wide customer base that values quality and efficacy in cosmetic products. Our dedication to sustainability drives us to use eco-friendly packaging and practices throughout our operations.
